subject: Matemática
description_pt: Reconhecer, nomear e comparar polígonos, considerando lados, vértices e ângulos, e classificá-los em regulares e não regulares, tanto em suas representações no plano como em faces de poliedros.

components.description_pt: Nomear e comparar polígonos com relação aos seus lados, vértices e ângulos
components.description_en: Name and compare polygons with respect to their sides, vertices, and angles
components.cc_component_description: Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts (e.g., number of sides and vertices/"corners") and other attributes (e.g., having sides of equal length).

components.description_pt: Classificar polígonos como regulares ou irregulares baseado em suas propriedades
components.description_en: Classify polygons as regular or irregular based on their properties
components.cc_component_description: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of perpendicular or parallel lines

components.description_pt: Identificar propriedades de polígonos em representações planas e nas faces de poliedros
components.description_en: Identify polygon properties in planar representations and in the faces of polyhedra
components.cc_component_description: Identify two-dimensional shapes with specified attributes, such as a given number of angles, sides, or equal faces

cc_matches.description: Classify two-dimensional figures based on the presence or absence of parallel or perpendicular lines, or the presence or absence of angles of a specified size. Recognize right triangles as a category, and identify right triangles.
Recognize and draw shapes having specified attributes, such as a given number of angles or a given number of equal faces. Identify triangles, quadrilaterals, pentagons, hexagons, and cubes.

Analyze and compare two- and three-dimensional shapes, in different sizes and orientations, using informal language to describe their similarities, differences, parts (e.g., number of sides and vertices/"corners") and other attributes (e.g., having sides of equal length).

prerequisites.description_pt: Reconhecer ângulos retos e não retos em figuras poligonais com o uso de dobraduras, esquadros ou softwares de geometria.
